overall: This library presents a vibrant, cross-cultural sonic journey with a strong dual focus on rhythm and emotion. Anchored heavily by Latin pop, reggaeton, and hip-hop, the collection effortlessly shifts between high-energy club anthems and traditional regional storytelling. Beneath the upbeat party tracks lies a deeply contemplative streak characterized by gentle acoustic ballads and minor-key intensity.

clusters.name: Midnight Cypher
clusters.description: Dominated by sharp lyricism and bouncy cadences, this cluster spotlights vocal-heavy hip-hop and playful urban flows.

clusters.name: Desert Waltz
clusters.description: Defined by regional Mexican storytelling and rare triple-meter rhythms, these tracks evoke a nostalgic and dust-swept charm.

clusters.name: Pale Melancholy
clusters.description: Stripped down and profoundly quiet, this acoustic sanctuary leans into tender sadness, soft vocals, and gentle introspection.

clusters.name: Sunlit Groove
clusters.description: Radiating warmth and optimism, this expansive group celebrates melodic pop, rock, and breezy Latin dance rhythms.

clusters.name: Neon Surge
clusters.description: Fueled by high-voltage electronics, live-room grit, and dark minor keys, this cluster thrives on raw, kinetic club and rock power.
